subject: CloudKart reseller addendum - pass-through exception request
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cloudkart.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@cloudkart.com
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reseller addendum - pass-through clause exception request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Legal at CloudKart reviewed the reseller addendum and there are two pass-through items we cannot accept as written: the invoice routing and the indemnity carve-out related to third-party marketplace fees. We've attached a marked-up Order Form and a short summary (both attached).

High-level ask: can Redwood accept an exception that (1) routes the marketplace usage fees to CloudKart (we'll be the billing entity for end customers) and (2) limits pass-through indemnity to breaches caused by Redwood systems only? Our procurement team says these are standard marketplace constraints.

We need confirmation by Monday (04/05) to keep the launch timeline. Happy to hop on a 30-min call if that helps.

Attachments: CloudKart_Requested_Changes_v3.pdf, OrderForm-CloudKart-Redlines.docx

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Partnerships
CloudKart
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cloudkart.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum - pass-through clause exception request

Alex — thanks for the clear summary and the redlines. Looping in Vanessa (partnerships lead) and Mina (legal ops lead) to triage.

Quick note on timing: we can triage internally this afternoon but need legal agreement on the exact carve language for indemnity. Two asks from our side to accelerate:
- Can you confirm whether CloudKart will accept a defined cap for pass-through liabilities (e.g., limited to fees collected on the marketplace for the disputed month)?
- If you have earlier precedent language from other marketplaces, please paste it inline or point to the clause in the PDF so Mina can compare.

If it's helpful, I'm available 11:00–12:00 PDT for a quick call. Otherwise Vanessa and Mina will propose redline language by EOD.

Best,
Jonas
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cloudkart.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum - pass-through clause exception request

Alex — thanks, appreciate the fast turnaround. Mina and I reviewed your PDF and the two requested exceptions look tradeable with clarified language. Proposed compromise below (tracking suggestions):

1) Billing routing
- Redwood agrees to allow CloudKart to be invoiced for marketplace usage when CloudKart is the contracted reseller and provides a valid reseller ID. Redwood will invoice CloudKart only for usage attributable to CloudKart-managed customers.
- Operational note: this requires CloudKart to send a monthly usage report and a signed confirmation email per month for reconciliation.

2) Pass-through indemnity carve (proposed language)
- "Redwood shall not be liable for indirect claims arising solely from third-party marketplace fees outside Redwood's control. Redwood's pass-through indemnity will be limited to direct losses attributable to Redwood's breach of the Agreement or Redwood's gross negligence, and limited in aggregate to the total fees paid to Redwood by CloudKart for the preceding three (3) months."

We think the language narrows scope but preserves Redwood's ability to protect against Redwood-originated failures. If CloudKart can accept the three-month fee cap, we can prepare a clean Order Form ready for signature and a tracked redline of the MSA for legal.

Attachment: Proposed_OrderForm_Clean_v1.docx (we'll upload to DocuSign once you confirm).

If you prefer a short call, Jonas and I can do 09:00 PDT Monday.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Channel Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cloudkart.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@cloudkart.com
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 17:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum - pass-through clause exception request

Vanessa / Jonas — appreciate the thoughtful compromise and proposed wording. CloudKart legal reviewed the proposed carve and the three-month fee cap is acceptable in principle, but they asked for one tweak: change the cap trigger to "fees paid to Redwood by CloudKart in the preceding two (2) billing cycles" (to align with CloudKart's month-to-month reconciliation cadence).

We can proceed on that basis. Contracts@cloudkart will send a short confirmation and we can expect the final clean Order Form for signature (DocuSign link preferred).

I'll look out for the DocuSign link — aiming to sign by Tue morning to keep the marketplace listing timeline.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Partnerships
CloudKart
